### Skip the read: talk to Walid in 30 min.
The best AI automation agencies in 2026 are AY Automate for full-service strategy, build, and maintenance under one roof; RZLT for AI-native growth marketing; Kanerika for data analytics paired with automation; Ema AI for no-code AI employee deployment; Sana Labs for knowledge and learning agents; and UiPath or Automation Anywhere if what you actually want is an enterprise RPA platform rather than a partner.

### Best AI automation agencies: a brief overview
| Agency | Best for | Pricing signal | Public reviews | Stack |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| AY Automate | Full-service AI automation: strategy, build, QA, and maintenance | Custom project-based; fractional CAIO retainer available | No public Clutch reviews yet | Workflow automation, AI agents, RAG pipelines, SaaS MVPs |
| Kanerika | Data analytics + AI/ML consulting with proprietary AI products | Custom engagement-based; mid-market rates | 5.0/5 on Clutch (18 reviews) | Data analytics, RPA, AI/ML, migration services |
| UiPath | Largest RPA ecosystem with agentic AI and process mining | From $25/month (Basic); Standard and Enterprise custom-quoted | 4.6/5 on G2 (7,768 reviews) | RPA, agentic automation, document processing, testing |
| Automation Anywhere | Cloud-native RPA with strong document processing (IQ Bot) | No public pricing; custom quotes only | 4.5/5 on G2 (5,705 reviews) | RPA, AI agents, intelligent document processing |
| LowCode Agency | Budget-conscious automation paired with custom app builds (Bubble, FlutterFlow, n8n, Make) | $50-99/hr; projects typically start under $10,000 | 4.9/5 on Clutch (34 reviews) | n8n, Make, Zapier, Bubble, FlutterFlow, Webflow, Airtable |
